title: Speed at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's speed at point B using conservation of mechanical energy (mgr = 1/2 mv_B^2).

title: Force ratio at B
description: Essential: Correctly determines the ratio F_N/(mg) at point B by applying Newton's second law for circular motion (F_N - mg = mv_B^2/r).

title: Energy to reach C
description: Important: Correctly applies conservation of mechanical energy to find the speed (v) the block must have when leaving the belt to just reach point C.

title: Kinematics on belt
description: Important: Correctly applies kinematic equations for uniformly accelerated motion to find displacements and times for deceleration and acceleration phases on the conveyor belt.

title: Total trip time
description: Essential: Correctly sums the individual time intervals (deceleration, acceleration, constant speed) to find the total time for the first round trip.

title: Friction work calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the total heat generated using the work-energy theorem (Q = μmg * total relative displacement).

title: Relative displacement
description: Important: Correctly computes the relative displacement between the block and the belt for both directions of motion to find the friction work.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs to velocities, accelerations, or displacements for the different motion phases on the belt.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, J) throughout the calculation and presents final answers with correct units.
